title: 第468章 我们是一个团伙第467章 求援遇袭
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: 呼啸而来的箭矢，虽只是元力凝聚而成，但威力也不容小觑。
眼看着即将射入秦逸体内之际，箭尖处，顿时又有无数细小的符纹闪烁出暴烈的光芒。
也就在这刹那之间，秦逸身上，猛然迸发出一片苍凉破败的天地异象。
剑墟法相！
箭尖与剑墟法相接触的刹那，便有大半细密的符纹，随之湮灭。
不等剑墟法相的力量，彻底将这一支元力箭矢摧毁。
元力箭矢，猛然爆开，发出巨大的炸响，掀起一股狂暴的气浪。
秦逸的身形，随着气浪而去，但却并未失去平衡，只不过是随风而动罢了。
“有点意思！”
冷笑声响起。
一名男子，手持大弓，站在不远处，脸上带着冰冷的笑容，道：“难怪只有无量境一重修为，竟然敢跟另外两个无量境低阶的家伙一起组队，进入这里。”
就犹如秦逸一样，手里还有一把剑，这个家伙的弓，也是随身携带的兵器，但只有弓，没有箭，只能以元力成箭。
秦逸盯着此人，马上就有所判断，这是一个无量境五重修为的家伙。
“无量境五重而已，本事不大，也敢学人抢东西？”
秦逸淡淡道。
一句话，顿时就让这家伙的表情变得有些扭曲起来。
“你一个无量境一重的废物，也敢看不起我无量境五重？”
“我就让你知道我的厉害！”
话音落下，此人手中的大弓，猛然抬起，紧接着拉开了弓弦。
弓开如满月！
“看我万箭齐发！”
一声大喝。
他捏着弓弦的手指，随之松开。
弓弦猛弹，发出巨大的嗡鸣声，紧接着，密密麻麻的箭矢，犹如蝗虫过境一般，朝着秦逸爆射而去。
秦逸冷哼一声，手中阔剑抡动，八荒伏天剑法，一剑耀沧澜！
剑光浩浩荡荡倾泻，将所有射杀而来的箭矢淹没！
一根根元力箭矢，在秦逸的剑光之中，快速湮灭！
持弓男子，脸上浮现惊愕之色，瞳孔猛地一缩，终于意识到眼前的目标，根本不是什么软柿子，而是一块梆硬的铁板。
他很果断，瞬间转身就逃！
可他刚转过身去，就感知到身后传来一阵爆鸣，不等他再做出任何反应，一把阔剑，便贯穿了他的后背，透过胸膛而出。
秦逸收剑。
男子倒在地上。
“兄弟……有话好好说……”
“我把日炎兽的兽核给你……我的火阳石也给你……”
content_en:
Although the roaring arrows are only made of condensed Yuan energy, their power cannot be underestimated.
Just as he was about to shoot into Qin Yi's body, countless small runes suddenly flashed violently at the tip of the arrow.
At this moment, a vision of desolate and ruined heaven and earth suddenly burst out from Qin Yi's body.
Sword Ruins Dharma Appearance!
The moment the arrow tip came into contact with the Sword Ruin Technique, most of the fine runes were annihilated.
Without waiting for the power of Jian Xu Dharma, this Yuanli arrow was completely destroyed.
"Boom!"
The Yuanli arrow exploded suddenly, making a huge explosion and setting off a violent wave of air.
Qin Yi's figure moved with the air waves, but he did not lose his balance, he just moved with the wind.
"It's interesting!"
A sneer sounded.
A man, holding a big bow, stood not far away, with a cold smile on his face, and said: "No wonder someone who is only at the first level of the Infinite Realm dares to form a team with two other low-level guys in the Infinite Realm and enter here."
Just like Qin Yi, he still has a sword in his hand. This guy's bow is also a weapon he carries with him, but he only has a bow and no arrows. He can only use Yuan Li to make arrows.
Qin Yi stared at this person and immediately judged that he was a guy with a fifth-level cultivation in the Infinite Realm.
"You're only at the fifth level of the Infinite Realm. You don't have much ability. How dare you imitate others and steal things?"
Qin Yi said lightly.
One sentence immediately made this guy's expression become a little distorted.
"You, a loser at the first level of the Infinite Realm, dare to look down on me, the fifth level of the Infinite Realm?"
"I'll let you know how powerful I am!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the big bow in this man's hand suddenly lifted up, and then he pulled out the bowstring.
The bow is as wide as the full moon!
"Look at me firing thousands of arrows!"
A loud shout.
He pinched the bow string with his fingers and then released it.
"Buzz!"
The bow string flicked violently, making a huge buzzing sound, and then, dense arrows shot towards Qin Yi like locusts passing through.
Qin Yi snorted coldly, swung the broad sword in his hand, and used the Bahuang Futian sword technique to shine in Canglan with one sword!
The sword light poured out mightily, drowning all the arrows that were shot at him!
Each Yuanli arrow was quickly annihilated in the light of Qin Yi's sword!
The man holding the bow had a look of astonishment on his face, his pupils shrank suddenly, and he finally realized that the target in front of him was not a soft persimmon at all, but a solid iron plate.
He was very decisive and turned around and ran away in an instant!
But as soon as he turned around, he felt an explosion coming from behind him. Before he could react, a broad sword penetrated his back and came out through his chest.
Qin Yi put away his sword.
The man fell to the ground.
"Brother...if you have something to say, please say it..."
"I'll give you the Sun Flame Beast's core... I'll also give you my Fire Sun Stone..."
